item.title: Family of man with rare leukaemia treatment blasts blackmail by air ambulance company
item.description: Abigail Borg, the wife of Sandro Grech said that an air ambulance company tried to squeeze every cent out of the family, while her husband remains sick and unable to travel to China for treatment

item.title: Malta to be promoted through four-year partnership with Melbourne-based football club
item.description: Melbourne-based club Caroline Springs George Cross Football Club was founded by Maltese migrants in 1947 and recently promoted to the National Premier League in Victoria, Australia

item.title: Equality Commission condemns Ricky Caruana for allowing sex offender to justify his actions
item.description: The National Commission for the Promotion of Equality called for Caruana to be sacked from his role as a PBS TV presenter following the Justin Haber episode • Parliamentary Secretary for Equality Rebecca Buttigieg slams 'unacceptable attempt' to trivialise sexual harassment

item.title: Murder trial underway 17 years after alleged shooting
item.description: Stephen Caruana is accused of murdering his wife's lover when he caught him in their home

item.title: 4,368 births, 4,176 deaths registered in Malta and Gozo in 2025
item.description: Malta Public Registry data shows Noah and Emma most popular names for boys and girls

item.title: Malta Dairy Products announces milk price increase
item.description: Malta Dairy Products has announced a price increase to several of its fresh milk products, citing increases in animal feed, packaging and transportation costs

item.title: MFSA launches revised regime for sponsors to strengthen Malta’s capital markets
item.description: Milestone initiative successfully delivers Pillar III of the MFSA’s Capital Markets Strategy, which focused specifically on strengthening the regulatory framework governing sponsors

item.title: MFSA warns of scam emails demanding fake tax payments on investments
item.description: The financial regulator says fraudsters are impersonating the authority and threatening to block funds unless victims pay supposed capital gains tax

item.title: Court dismisses medical negligence claims after patient underwent unnecessary surgery
item.description: The court found no evidence that the medical professionals acted with negligence or that their treatment of the plaintiff in a case that lasted 25 years

item.title: Compensation cut in Mater Dei swab negligence case despite court upholding hospital fault
item.description: An appeals court has reduced damages awarded to a woman who had a surgical swab left inside her body for three months after an operation at Mater Dei Hospital, while confirming that the hospital was responsible for the medical error
